title: BLACK+DECKER Pet Hair Roller: Remy's Test Notes
description: We tested the BLACK+DECKER pet hair remover roller on black felt couches, a comforter, and clothes. At around $16, is it worth ditching lint rollers?
card_summary: Tested on a black felt couch, regular couch, comforter, and clothes. Great swap for lint rollers.
lede: Tested on black felt couches, a regular couch, a bed comforter, and clothes. At around $16, it is one of the better swaps you can make if you are tired of buying lint roller refills.
verdict_text: Works on every surface we tested. Reusable, cheap, and Remy approved of the clean couch it left behind.

surfaces.name: Black felt couch
surfaces.note: Worst case for visibility, picked up Lab fur cleanly in a few passes.

surfaces.name: Regular fabric couch
surfaces.note: Worked just as well. No snags and no damage.

surfaces.name: Bed comforter
surfaces.note: Handled the fluffier surface without getting stuck.

surfaces.name: Clothes
surfaces.note: Good for a quick pass before leaving the house.

what_we_tested: Remy sheds constantly and our black felt couches show every single hair. That was the hardest test. We also ran it across a regular fabric couch, a bed comforter, and some clothes.
what_worked: It actually picks up the hair, rather than just pushing it around. The fur collects in a compartment you empty out. No sticky tape to peel and no replacement rolls to buy. For around $16, it is better long-term value than lint rollers by a lot.
what_didnt_work: Nothing major. It is not instant. You need a few passes on heavy fur areas, and it works better with long strokes in one direction than going back and forth.
remys_take: Remy's contribution was jumping back onto the clean couch immediately after we finished. That is basically a five-star review from a Lab.
worth_buying: Yes. If you have a shedding dog and you are still buying lint roller refills, this is an easy upgrade. It costs about the same as a two-pack of refills and you never have to buy it again.

faqs.question: Does it work on black couches?
faqs.answer: Yes. It picked up Lab fur on black felt in a few passes without residue or damage.

faqs.question: Is it reusable?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is no tape to replace. Empty the hair compartment and use it again.

faqs.question: Does it work on clothes?
faqs.answer: Yes. It works on clothes, furniture, and comforters.

faqs.question: What is the best way to use it?
faqs.answer: Use long strokes in one direction. It picks up more fur than going back and forth.
